items.title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF

sentences.en: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF.
Today, we are expanding our web application firewall (WAF) by adding two new capabilities: full transaction detections and response rules.
Full transaction detections evaluate each HTTP request alongside its response to identify evidence of exploitation.
It helps answer both "Does this request look malicious?"
and "What happened when the application handled it?"
Response rules can then block the origin’s response before it reaches the requester.

These are valuable protections because the latest frontier models are uncovering vulnerabilities buried deep in widely used software, giving defenders clarity on what to fix — and attackers new paths to exploit.
The recent php2shell vulnerability shows the stakes: a flaw in a common software component can put applications across the Internet at risk.
AI agents scanning for vulnerabilities can be extremely persistent, adapting payloads using feedback, and chaining vulnerabilities, credentials, and permissions.
An application's response can reveal whether an attempt worked and give an attacker information that helps them go deeper.
Inspecting incoming requests remains essential for stopping recognizable attacks before they reach an application.
But some threats become clear only when the request is considered alongside what the origin returns.

items.title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability

sentences.en: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability.
Today, Calif.io, Wiz, OpenAI and Quarkslab disclosed two vulnerabilities in PHP, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 and known as php2shell .

The vulnerabilities affect all web servers running PHP 5.4 or later and they may allow an attacker to cause denial of service, remote code execution, and data exposure when an application processes specially crafted HTTP traffic.
Cloudflare has been part of a coordinated effort to deploy mitigations to protect the Internet, working with PHP foundation , OpenAI and Wiz among others.
Cloudflare has developed and deployed web application firewall (WAF) protections since early October 2026, which were deployed about 9 hours ahead of public disclosure.
Starting on October 21 3:02 am UTC, Cloudflare customers using our free or paid WAF were protected by default against php2shell.
Cloudflare successfully deployed multiple mitigations for all its customers while the vulnerability was leaked before the official release date and we observed attack traffic targeting our customers.
We observed how attackers were mutating the attack payload to try to bypass our protections by tracking the volume of matches and cross-referencing with the rule logic.
Protecting against php2shell required more than standard request-based rules.
Request data alone does not always provide enough evidence to distinguish an exploit from legitimate traffic.
The origin’s response adds context, helping identify whether an exploit succeeded while reducing the risk of false positives.
To deliver this protection, we developed full transaction detection, a new Cloudflare WAF capability that combines signals from the request and response within the same HTTP transaction.

items.title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents

sentences.en: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents.
AI can write code and pass the bar exam, but it still struggles to buy a pair of shoes online.
That’s because websites were built for humans, not agents.
Most agents that shop for someone today work from a site’s HTML — they look at the page, guess which button does what, click, and try again when they get it wrong.
This process is slow, uses a lot of tokens, and something as seemingly innocuous as a theme change can break it.
Enter WebMCP: a browser standard from Google that gives AI agents structured tools on a page, like search_products .
Instead of hunting for buttons, the agent calls the exact tool it needs directly, making shopping faster, cheaper, and far more reliable.

Because WebMCP is still an experimental proposed browser standard in early preview, it’s currently available behind experimental Chrome flags ( chrome://flags/#enable-webmcp-testing ), in Chrome Origin Trials, in some agentic browsers, and across developer environments like Cloudflare Kitesurf .
In August, we launched edge implementation of WebMCP in beta.
Turn it on, and Cloudflare injects a tiny script at the edge to make those tools available automatically, without site owners writing a single line of code.
Commerce.com , a flexible commerce platform built for the age of AI, already uses Cloudflare to run their almost 100,000 domains.
So when the preview came out, they asked: Can we turn this on for all of our stores at once?

items.title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know

sentences.en: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised.
Here's what you need to know.
On October 19, 2026, at approximately 17:00 UTC, Cloudflare became aware that private keys associated with eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were compromised.
These certificates were widely trusted by browsers, operating systems, and also within Cloudflare.
Because the keys themselves are weak, an attacker can create a forged certificate for any domain and use it to impersonate servers to intercept or modify traffic.
This is a serious security incident with implications across the Internet.
For reference, here is a link to more information about how SSL certificates work and why they are so critical to the operation of the Internet.
We immediately prioritized patching critical services across Cloudflare to protect our customers ahead of the public disclosure of the vulnerability.
Our security review has not identified active exploitation of this issue on Cloudflare services.
We have released updates for the Cloudflare One Clients, also known as WARP or the 1.1.1.1 app, and Cloudflare Tunnel, also known as cloudflared.
We have also deployed mitigations across our CDN, Developer, and Zero Trust products.
If you are using Cloudflare Zero Trust with Gateway and an up-to-date client (see below), you are automatically protected.

items.title: Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services

sentences.en: Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services.
sentences.zh: 隆重推出Amazon ECS网关：针对ECS服务的全托管入口解决方案。

sentences.en: When platform teams manage containerized applications at scale on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) , configuring ingress networking for each service often becomes a bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 当平台团队在Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)上大规模管理容器化应用程序时，为每个服务配置入口网络通常会成为瓶颈。

sentences.en: For every new service, teams must provision and connect Application Load Balancers (ALBs) , AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificates, AWS WAF web ACLs, and security groups, then keep those resources in sync as services scale, update, or operate.
sentences.zh: 对于每项新服务，团队必须配置和连接应用程序负载平衡器(ALB)、AWS证书管理器(ACM)证书、AWS WAF Web ACL和安全组，然后在服务扩展、更新或运行时保持这些资源同步。

sentences.en: This per-service overhead slows down deployment velocity and increases the risk of configuration drift across an organization.
sentences.zh: 这种每服务开销降低了部署速度，并增加了整个组织中配置漂移的风险。

sentences.en: Today, we’re announcing Amazon ECS Gateway , a new account-level resource that simplifies ingress networking for containerized workloads by dynamically provisioning and managing the necessary infrastructure on your behalf, with all resources created directly in your account.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们宣布推出Amazon ECS Gateway ，这是一种新的帐户级资源，通过在您的帐户中直接创建所有资源，代表您动态配置和管理必要的基础架构，简化容器化工作负载的入口网络。

sentences.en: ECS Gateway introduces a clear separation of responsibilities between platform teams and application teams.
sentences.zh: ECS Gateway在平台团队和应用程序团队之间引入了明确的职责分工。

sentences.en: Platform teams create and configure a gateway, defining organizational networking standards including subnets, security groups, TLS certificates, listener settings, and WAF web ACLs, in a single place.
sentences.zh: 平台团队创建和配置网关，在一个地方定义组织网络标准，包括子网、安全组、TLS证书、侦听器设置和WAF Web ACL。

sentences.en: They then associate the gateway with one or more ECS clusters, making it available to services running on those clusters.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们将网关与一个或多个ECS群集相关联，使其可用于在这些群集上运行的服务。

sentences.en: Application teams opt their services in by adding a gateway connector parameter when creating or updating a service.
sentences.zh: 应用程序团队在创建或更新服务时通过添加网关连接器参数来选择其服务。

sentences.en: ECS provisions the required per-service resources automatically: an ACM certificate, a unique DNS hostname, listener rules, target groups, and a service security group that permits inbound traffic only from the ALB.
sentences.zh: ECS自动调配所需的每项服务资源： ACM证书、唯一DNS主机名、侦听器规则、目标组以及仅允许来自ALB的入站流量的服务安全组。

sentences.en: No networking expertise required.
sentences.zh: 无需网络专业知识。

sentences.en: ECS Gateway offers host-based routing using ALBs and enables up to 25 services to share a single ALB, optimizing infrastructure costs.
sentences.zh: ECS网关使用ALB提供基于主机的路由，并允许多达25个服务共享单个ALB ，从而优化基础设施成本。

items.title: How 3 Java Champions are using GitHub Copilot for increased productivity

sentences.en: How 3 Java Champions are using GitHub Copilot for increased productivity.
sentences.zh: 3 Java倡导者如何使用GitHub Copilot提高生产力。

sentences.en: AI coding tools can generate code quickly, but speed alone does not solve the hardest software engineering problems.
sentences.zh: 人工智能编码工具可以快速生成代码，但仅靠速度并不能解决最困难的软件工程问题。

sentences.en: Developers still need to provide context, validate results, protect maintainability, and remain accountable for what ships.
sentences.zh: 开发人员仍然需要提供上下文，验证结果，保护可维护性，并对哪些内容负责。

sentences.en: To learn how experienced developers strike that balance, we spoke with three Java Champions, all with over a decade of experience in using Java.
sentences.zh: 为了了解经验丰富的开发人员如何实现这一平衡，我们采访了三位Java倡导者，他们在使用Java方面都有十多年的经验。

sentences.en: They shared concrete examples of using GitHub Copilot in production and open source, along with the practices they use to turn AI-generated output into reliable software.
sentences.zh: 他们分享了在生产和开源中使用GitHub Copilot的具体例子，以及他们将人工智能生成的输出转化为可靠软件的实践。

sentences.en: Here are the tips they shared with us.
sentences.zh: 以下是他们与我们分享的建议。

sentences.en: Meet the Java Champions Vlad Mihalcea , founder of Hypersistence and author of the book High-Performance Java Persistence Patrick Baumgartner , software crafter at 42talents with 20+ years of Java experience Frank Delporte , senior technical writer at Azul and maintainer of Foojay.io with 15+ years of Java experience Vlad Mihalcea GitHub profile: @vladmihalcea How has GitHub Copilot helped you recently?
sentences.zh: 认识Java拥护者Vlad Mihalcea ，他是Hypersistence的创始人，也是《High-Performance Java Persistence》一书的作者Patrick Baumgartner ，他是42名员工的软件工匠，拥有20多年的Java经验Frank Delporte ， Azul的高级技术作家和Foojay.io的维护者，拥有15年以上的Java经验Vlad Mihalcea GitHub个人资料： @ vladmihalcea GitHub Copilot最近如何帮助您？

sentences.en: I ve been using it to analyze, design, and implement various features in both Hypersistence Utils and Hypersistence Optimizer.
sentences.zh: 我一直在使用它来分析、设计和实现Hypersistence Utils和Hypersistence Optimizer中的各种功能。

sentences.en: For example, I ve been wanting for a long time to develop a web application that provides Optimizer event history so we can see how performance improvement efforts are materializing in application performance.
sentences.zh: 例如，我一直希望开发一个提供Optimizer事件历史记录的Web应用程序，以便我们可以看到性能改进工作如何在应用程序性能中实现。

sentences.en: Before AI, I kept postponing this task because it would have taken me weeks to develop.
sentences.zh: 在人工智能之前，我一直推迟这项任务，因为它需要花费数周的时间来发展。

sentences.en: But using Copilot is like having a new team member, so I used it to create an app that will ship in the next version of Hypersistence Optimizer.
sentences.zh: 但使用Copilot就像有一个新的团队成员，所以我用它来创建一个应用程序，该应用程序将在下一版本的Hypersistence Optimizer中发布。

sentences.en: Instead of weeks, this task took just two days to implement.
sentences.zh: 这项任务只花了两天时间就完成了，而不是几周。
